description: This file contains unit tests for NATS streaming integration within an Orleans-based application. It sets up test clusters, configures NATS stream providers, and defines multiple test cases for different streaming scenarios using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: NatsStreamTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying NATS streaming integration with Orleans, including setup, teardown, and various streaming scenario tests.

methods.name: NatsStreamTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test class, checks NATS server availability, and sets up connections.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the Orleans test cluster with NATS stream providers and storage options.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the NATS connection and cleans up existing streams before tests.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the NATS connection and cleans up streams after tests.

methods.name: Nats_01_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain

methods.description: Test case for one producer grain and one consumer client scenario.

methods.name: Nats_03_OneProducerClientOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Test case for one producer client and one consumer grain scenario.

methods.name: Nats_04_OneProducerClientOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Test case for one producer client and one consumer client scenario.

methods.name: Nats_05_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Test case for many producer grains and many consumer grains.

methods.description: Test case for many producer clients and many consumer grains.

methods.description: Test case for many producer clients and many consumer clients.

methods.name: Nats_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains

methods.description: Test case for many consumer grains and many producer grains with the same configuration.

methods.description: Test case for many producer grains and many consumer clients with the same configuration.
